result.stop_rule_applied: The pre-implementation reviewer timed out, so the workflow stopped before the paid worker.

diagnosis.evidence: Claude completed a detailed review in a Write tool input targeting its user plan directory, but permission mode plan and the read-only tool list made Write unavailable. The tool failed at 599.5 seconds and the stage timed out before Claude returned the review as final text.

change_control.correction: Use Claude permission mode dontAsk with only read-only tools, explicitly require response text rather than a plan file, and allow 900 seconds for each Opus review stage.

interpretation: This is a valid workflow failure and evidence that harness modes can interact badly even when the model produced useful reasoning.
It is not an OpenCode or Kimi result because the paid worker was never started.
No OpenRouter budget was consumed by this attempt.
